invariant: Every folded NoteBox exposes the full component preferred width, including its shadow delta, and anchors at the truncated live-segment edge merged at the component's top and bottom. This also applies to message-attached notes. ArrowAndNoteBox adds the actual padded arrow preferred width. Shadowing changes preferred dimensions only where the Java component declares it; group and activation backgrounds carry their component shadow paint without enlarging their preferred widths.
causal_divergence: Rust excludes attached notes from live-segment maps and uses center-only anchors, losing activation-edge offsets. The raw folded component width omits deltaShadow, while visible polygon size correctly excludes it. This shifts shadowed left-note constraints and diagram origins. ArrowAndNoteBox reconstruction omits arrow text padding when choosing max(actual, preferred) width. Finally group backgrounds and activation bars omit the shadow filter despite global shadow style.
planned_change: Use the same NoteBox segment and full preferred-width model for attached and standalone folded notes; preserve the distinction between component origin and visible polygon. Include padded arrow preferred width in note wrappers. Resolve the existing note shadow state into its component delta and use existing sequence-local shadow filter output on Java-shadowed group backgrounds and activation rectangles. Keep group foreground/tab paint unshadowed and activation preferred width unchanged.
perturbation_axes: Shadow on/off and note-specific shadow state with left/right/over notes
Attached/standalone notes and activation depth at note top/bottom
Padding and declaration order, nested groups and activation segments crossing delays
verification_plan: Preserve all prior padding and shadow cases
Main sequence and both full tiers plus complete heldout inventory
acceptance: Maker candidate; independent checker required. No shared SVG/font/style API edits.
